apps.name: MangaView
apps.subtitle: Manga/webtoon reader (MVP)
apps.localizedDescription: Unofficial reader for a manga/webtoon mirror site family. No address is bundled - you enter a mirror URL on first run. MVP: home browsing, search, episode list, WebView reader.

versions.localizedDescription: Reader top bar no longer overlaps the status bar and now slides fully out of sight on scroll. Home/search cards no longer overflow their grid cell on a two-line title. Known issue: cover art and reader images may fail to load on networks that SNI-filter the site's CDN; never run on a real iOS device yet.
